text: それでは　＊を　しばらく　あずかるぞ　てきとうに　じかんが　たったら　またきなさい

structure.jp: ＊を　しばらく　あずかるぞ
structure.en: I'll look after ＊ for a while

structure.jp: てきとうに　じかんが　たったら
structure.en: once a suitable amount of time has passed

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'once that has happened'. じかんが　たったら = 'once time has passed'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい after a verb is a firm but kind order. きなさい = 'come'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end makes the statement sound firm and a bit rough. あずかるぞ = 'I'll look after it, all right'.
